_about: Curated wheelchair-accessible ride options for the New York City area. The app never books through these services. It shows the phone number or link and a draft message the person can copy or have read aloud. Check each number against its source before a release; entries with a broken or missing source are removed.

rides.name: Access-A-Ride (MTA paratransit)
rides.notes: Pre-approved paratransit. Trips are booked by phone, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., seven days a week. Callers outside the New York metro area dial 718-393-4999.

rides.name: NYC Accessible Dispatch (wheelchair-accessible taxis)
rides.notes: Call to request an accessible yellow or green taxi from the e-hail companies. Dial 711 for relay service.
